description: This file defines a controller class in a PHP project that manages the saving and editing of qualification education data within the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract Vue controller and configures a Vue component based on request parameters.

classes.name: SaveQualificationEducationController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for rendering the appropriate Vue component for saving or editing qualification education data, based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component to be rendered. Checks if an 'id' attribute exists in the request and sets up the component accordingly.
